title: FEATURE — auto-deliver: also send pending post-queue.jsonl videos (multiformat + vlogs)
rationale: posting-auto-deliver.ts only delivers videos from publish-ledger.jsonl (15-stage pipeline). post-queue.jsonl has 6 pending multiformat/vlog videos that are never delivered. Extend auto-deliver to ALSO check post-queue.jsonl after the ledger batch: if batchSize not yet filled, pull from post-queue pending entries where file exists, send via Telegram, mark as posted in post-queue. This delivers multiformat and vlog content without needing a TikTok token.
outputs: scripts/scs001/posting-auto-deliver.ts (modified — add post-queue delivery after ledger batch)
success_criteria: After ledger batch, auto-deliver checks post-queue.jsonl for pending entries with valid files
Sends up to (batchSize - sentCount) videos from post-queue via Telegram
Marks sent entries as status=posted in post-queue.jsonl
Appends to auto-delivered.jsonl like ledger videos
Smoke test with fake token: logs post-queue candidate videos without 'Gate met' skip

tasks.description: In scripts/scs001/posting-auto-deliver.ts, after the existing ledger-based send loop completes (near end of main()), add a second pass: read workspace/scs001/post-queue.jsonl, find pending entries where existsSync(entry.file) is true and entry.video_id not in deliveredAll, send up to (batchSize - sentCount) of them via sendVideoFile(), mark each as posted in post-queue.jsonl (rewrite the file with status=posted for sent entries), append to auto-delivered.jsonl. Keep changes contained to main() function. No new helper functions needed — reuse readJsonLines and the existing sendVideoFile/appendFileSync pattern.
